title: Sun Park alleged organised operational unit — narrow functional map
definition: For this page only, organised operational unit means Gil Marer / Project Sun Rock's attributed allegation that distinct private actors, the Sun Park Community organ, the insolvency-administration interface and the judicial-supervision layer converged functionally around specified acts, documents, authority claims and outcomes. It does not assert one legal person, one company, a criminal organisation, a conspiracy, shared intent, or automatic responsibility.

publication_boundaries: No node acquires another node's act, knowledge, intent, benefit or liability by association.
The Community organ is not treated as owner of the hotel or as an unlimited authority over private units.
The Insolvency Administrator and Judge remain institutionally and legally distinct from the five private actors.
The functional frame is an attributed analytical hypothesis, not an adjudicated finding of a criminal organisation, conspiracy or common enterprise.
RICPE, Lava Verde, Club SEI, MYND Yaiza and Orion are continuity/context nodes unless a source establishes a narrower transaction-specific role.
The 26 June 2018 suspension and other corrective/adverse records remain visible beside the allegations.
Right of reply, correction and exculpatory evidence remain open.
Professional, banking and media witness/custodian nodes are outside the alleged operational unit unless transaction-specific evidence proves a narrower role.

Do not state that Ref21, Ref22 or Ref24 are fully downloadable from the public GitLab site until route-level verification confirms complete public-safe files; as of 21 September 2026 that condition is not met.

witness_custodian_nodes.name: PwC / Landwell-PwC / Carlos Saavedra and 2016 team
witness_custodian_nodes.role: Prior professional adviser and contemporaneous custodian of Sun Park Community, accounts, unit/title, legal-strategy and AC-contact evidence. The client expressly directed a penal route in June/July 2016; Miguel Hernández/PwC acknowledged the decision with Carlos Saavedra copied; PwC later confirmed a general telephone contact with the Insolvency Administrator.
witness_custodian_nodes.boundary: This makes PwC a critical witness/custodian to what was known, analysed, instructed and communicated. It does not establish that PwC independently found a crime, committed a crime, assisted wrongdoing, breached confidentiality or misused information.

witness_custodian_nodes.name: RSM Spain / historical San Telmo perimeter
witness_custodian_nodes.period: San Telmo source 2021; RSM integration 2024+; ethics review 2026
witness_custodian_nodes.role: The historical source is Eduardo Sánchez's 30 November 2021 San Telmo statement that the firm introduced clients into the first RICPE investment being discussed. RSM later integrated the San Telmo team and has a separate ethics/independence review under NNR4-1025C2F66.
witness_custodian_nodes.boundary: RSM is not retroactively attributed San Telmo conduct or liability merely because of later team integration. The statement does not prove Borja–Eduardo coordination, transfer of insolvency information, breach or unlawfulness.

witness_custodian_nodes.name: Grant Thornton / Cuyás Canarias perimeter
witness_custodian_nodes.period: 2020 professional-conflict/forensic proposal record; later professional continuity and 2024_04 review
witness_custodian_nodes.role: A 2020 conflict/confidentiality/forensic-proposal process concerning Sun Park / Concurso 36/2012 is a material professional record. Later public professional material and the internal 2024_04 correspondence create preservation, conflict and file-separation questions.
witness_custodian_nodes.boundary: A proposal, conflict check, later professional relationship or internal review does not prove that a forensic engagement was executed, that confidential information moved, or that Grant Thornton participated in wrongdoing.

witness_custodian_nodes.name: CaixaBank, S.A.
witness_custodian_nodes.period: banking/litigation record; Valencia witness and later financing context
witness_custodian_nodes.role: The controlled Valencia record says the Insolvency Administrator's testimony was admitted at CaixaBank's request and Aweswell adhered. The bank also sits in a separate banking/credit and later hotel-financing context requiring transaction-specific reconciliation.
witness_custodian_nodes.boundary: Do not rewrite the record as independent equal selection by both sides: CaixaBank initiated the witness request and Aweswell adhered. The witness request, financing relationships or litigation do not establish collusion, partiality, conflict or criminal liability.

witness_custodian_nodes.name: Uría Menéndez
witness_custodian_nodes.period: reported 2015 contact; RICPE professional/DD architecture 2020–2021; production request 2026
witness_custodian_nodes.role: The public witness map preserves a reported 3 July 2015 AC–Rubio contact, Uría's named role in the 2020 RICPE professional-processing architecture, the July 2021 certification boundary on full due diligence, and later production requests concerning title, encumbrances, suitability, risks and project scope.
witness_custodian_nodes.boundary: Professional involvement or a reported contact is not a finding of conflict, breach, liability or wrongdoing; mandate, client, scope, knowledge and actual work product must be proved from the firm's records.

witness_custodian_nodes.name: Cajasiete
witness_custodian_nodes.role: Cajasiete is relevant as a banking, financing-comparability and internal-review custodian. Its 18 September 2026 response states that supplemental material was incorporated, the April decision was unchanged, and the matter remained registered with confidentiality/restricted access.
witness_custodian_nodes.boundary: The record does not establish that Cajasiete knowingly participated in wrongdoing. The live question is what records, conflicts, KYC/risk inputs, valuations, guarantees, decision owners and preservation trail exist.

witness_custodian_nodes.name: CANARIAS7
witness_custodian_nodes.period: 30 May 2022 publication trace; later public-availability gap and 2026 journalist contact
witness_custodian_nodes.role: The archive preserves a 30 May 2022 CANARIAS7 article as a public chronology checkpoint, a later same-URL availability/404 record, and 2026 exchanges with journalists seeking a clearer evidence-led explanation.
witness_custodian_nodes.boundary: Publication, removal, a 404 or later journalist contact does not prove censorship, influence, complicity, knowledge of the full case or wrongdoing by the newsroom.

witness_custodian_nodes.name: elEconomista / Javier Romera
witness_custodian_nodes.period: advanced pre-publication verification January 2025; renewed source dialogue 2026
witness_custodian_nodes.role: The direct record shows an active pre-publication process: on 17 January 2025 Romera said the story needed to be 'bien atada' and that he had been asked to wait for judicial orders; on 20 January he confirmed receipt of an adverse LPB judgment described as an auto and wrote that with it the outlet could not publish.
witness_custodian_nodes.boundary: No current controlled evidence establishes collusion, censorship, bad faith, criminality or knowing mischaracterisation by Romera or elEconomista. The physical sender, framing and native inbound transmission remain unresolved.
